description: Compare 2 to 5 homes in one call: size, the amenities guests choose by, review counts, each home's own check-in time, deposit and pet policy, and with dates, availability and the stay total for each. Use it when a guest is deciding between homes.

check_in.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD. Give both dates to get totals.

pets.description: Whether the guest is bringing a pet.

property_ids.description: Property ids or slugs from search results or booking links.

name: compare_properties

available.description: Only present when dates were given. A reason of not_checked means this home's availability could not be read, not that it is booked.

details_available.description: Only present, and only false, when this home's record could not be loaded. Such a row carries no name, place, amenity or review fields at all -- read detail_note, and call get_property_details for it again.

from_price_note.description: Only present when from_price_per_night is null: what we can and cannot see about this home's calendar. Call get_availability before suggesting dates; do not describe the home as booked out or as ready to book.

from_price_per_night.description: Starting nightly rate. Null means no starting rate is published for this home, never that it is free -- read from_price_note.

highlights.description: Up to three short phrases an agent can repeat when recommending the home.

neighbourhood.description: Neighbourhood-level location only; the exact address is shared after booking.

pets_allowed.description: Omitted when pet policy could not be verified.

review_count.description: How many 4- and 5-star reviews this home has. Never present this as, or derive, an average rating.

review_sources.description: Which platforms those reviews came from.

title: Compare homes side by side
